lede: The biggest thing on the docket this week is Carhenge — the proposed redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific Ave gets two separate hearings on Tuesday, September 30: a special HARC session reviewing preliminary architecture for multiple building clusters, and a Town Council appeal hearing on the lot subdivision that a law firm challenged after P&Z approved it in July. Alongside that, the Gondola Leadership Committee takes up a consequential choice Monday between federal funding and local project delivery, and the County commissioners workshop a proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee on Tuesday. It's a full week.

notable.stake: Council decides federal vs. local funding path for gondola replacement.

Council hears appeal that could block the Carhenge lot consolidation entirely.
